result.explanation: Changed edits outside groups create bounded undo entries and clear redo. Group edits remain unrecorded; outermost commit records only a changed transaction, while cancel restores its snapshot. Undo and redo exchange snapshots only when available and never operate inside groups. No-op operations preserve histories.
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){function copy(o){var n=Object.create(null),ks=Object.keys(o);for(var i=0;i<ks.length;i++)n[ks[i]]=o[ks[i]];return n}function same(a,b){var ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<ak.length;i++){var k=ak[i];if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||a[k]!==b[k])return false}return true}function bound(a){while(a.length>config.limit)a.shift()}var s=state;if(s===null){s={d:copy(config.initial),u:[],r:[],g:[]}}var e=event,t=e.type;if(t==='begin'){s.g.push(copy(s.d))}else if(t==='set'||t==='delete'){var n=copy(s.d),k=e.key,has=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(n,k);if(t==='set')n[k]=e.value;else if(has)delete n[k];if(!same(n,s.d)){if(s.g.length===0){s.u.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.u);s.r=[]}s.d=n}}else if(t==='commit'&&s.g.length){var old=s.g.pop();if(s.g.length===0&&!same(old,s.d)){s.u.push(old);bound(s.u);s.r=[]}}else if(t==='cancel'&&s.g.length){s.d=s.g.pop()}else if(t==='undo'&&s.g.length===0&&s.u.length){s.r.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.r);s.d=s.u.pop()}else if(t==='redo'&&s.g.length===0&&s.r.length){s.u.push(copy(s.d));bound(s.u);s.d=s.r.pop()}return{state:s,output:{document:copy(s.d),canUndo:s.g.length===0&&s.u.length>0,canRedo:s.g.length===0&&s.r.length>0,depth:s.g.length}}}
